notes.title: Demo is live !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860201/55b5faa45e29817ca1983f31e988a90ee8ff8d01.png
Hello Ultra Sentai Rangers,
The demo is now live for Steam's Remote Play Together Fest!

Play locally with your friends, against our bots, or online through Steam Remote Play(check out our tutorial to use Steam Remote Play at the end of this post).

Demo content:

4 Ultra Sentai Color Ranger : discover and experience the powers of our rangers, get ready for super fast moves !
Chromatic Battle - Fire Qi-Bullets to spread your Color-Qi to the greatest number of Qi-Cells to win the match. Play free-for-all or even in team(2VS2,1VS2,1VS3) !
Time Trial - Race against the clock solo or in team ! A time trial tournament will be ongoing and we have special prizes for the best sentai.
6 power-ups : What is a sentai without a full arsenal of power-ups ? Brace yourself for some colorful explosions !
9 maps: Get a taste of Neo-Tokyo with its bumpers, teleporters and other hazards !

Remote Play Together ?
Unfamiliar with Remote Play Together? It's easy! Simply launch the Quadricolor Demo, Shift-Tab (or Alt-Tab) to your friends list, and invite anyone to play! You'll then automatically stream your game session to them, and they'll stream their inputs to you! Be sure to use "Fast Quality" mode for a better Ultra Sentai experience and that's it, you're playing together remotely!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860201/adb07b0f2ed4efec284ef303316ecf184505e96f.png
